description:
Checks whether a public contract value is above the EU procurement threshold. Intended for requests where the user asks whether a contract must be advertised EU-wide or which procurement regime applies. Uses the thresholds valid 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31 (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/2152); the EU revises them every two years, the previous values (valid 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31) are returned in `schwelle_alt_eur` with an explanation in `schwelle_hinweis`. Returns whether the contract is above the threshold, the regime (VgV, VOB/A-EU, SektVO, KonzVgV) and, below the threshold, the sub-threshold limits for the federal government and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern (Art. 4 Directive 2014/24/EU). Which procedure types are permitted is answered by find_procurement_procedures. Key output fields: oberschwellig (boolean), schwelle_eur, regime, rechtsgrundlage, gueltigkeit.

Example user questions: "Liegt mein Auftrag über dem EU-Schwellenwert?"; "Muss ich europaweit ausschreiben?"; "Wie hoch ist der Schwellenwert für Liefer- und Dienstleistungen?"; "Ab welchem Betrag gilt die VgV?"; "Unterschwellenvergabe oder EU-Vergabe?"

auftraggeber.description: Type of contracting authority: bund=federal ministry, sonstige=state/municipality/other public body, sektoren=utilities (energy/water/transport), konzession=concession grantor.

leistungsart.description: Type of service (same name and values as in find_procurement_procedures): bau=construction, liefer=supply/goods, dienst=services, sozial=social and other special services. Alias accepted: leistung.

wert.description: Estimated contract value (net EUR). Accepts German thousands separator: 250.000 or decimal comma 250.000,50.

name: check_eu_threshold
